title: DriverAssist InjectLow process handle state

contains.const: InjectLow owns a process handle state variable initialized to NULL before any finish edge

contracts: InjectLow owns a process handle state variable initialized to NULL before any finish edge
InjectLow_OpenProcess returns a real process handle only after OpenProcess succeeds and creation time matches
OpenProcess failure and creation-time mismatch leave InjectLow hProcess NULL
finish cleanup tests only the initialized hProcess state before API_INJECT_COMPLETE failure notification and CloseHandle
CloseHandle is called only for a non-null process handle produced by InjectLow_OpenProcess
driver-not-ready early exit does not read an uninitialized process handle
path allocation cleanup remains independent from process handle cleanup
successful injection GuiServer MountManager and API_INJECT_COMPLETE topology are unchanged
failed injection still reports API_INJECT_COMPLETE error only when a target process handle was legally opened
runtime_gates: driver-not-ready injection request proving no invalid handle read and no CloseHandle call
OpenProcess failure injection proving hProcess remains NULL and cleanup skips process-handle actions
creation-time mismatch injection proving opened process handle is closed inside InjectLow_OpenProcess and outer cleanup skips process-handle actions
successful open followed by later failure proving API_INJECT_COMPLETE error notification and CloseHandle still run once
